name: a-passage-with-no-source-is-never-cited
description: SPEC.md 3.7, 4.1 (v1.18): a plain knowledge broker keeps working and is lifted to passages with no known origin. The passage still reaches the Brain; with citation on, the answer is returned unchanged, because a passage whose source is unknown is never cited. An implementation that credits a blank, or drops plain brokers, fails here.
prompt: what is our refund policy for enterprise customers
knowledgePassages: Refund policy. Enterprise customers may request a refund within 90 days of purchase.
